Local checks and finite models; no hosted CI or external-client compatibility claim.

regression_evidence: Seven original nonempty fixed-stride fixtures missed singleton or minority stripe colors. Full-source histograms pass them, including nonzero origins; earlier transparent-sample regressions remain covered.
Replacing every comparison cell palette with the first candidate fails two exact-pixel reference checks.
Replacing application EncodeContext with legacy Encode fails five deterministic cancellation checks; background GIF palette training also fails its cancellation bound.
Six pre-change output hashes verify byte compatibility for PNG, JPEG, GIF, SVG, PBM and ASCII.
Original CLI silently accepted inspect render flags; unregistered-flag diagnostics also failed command-context checks before correction.
Original mixed-edit handler lost the latest control value. Removing active numeric-input preservation reproduces seed -17 becoming 17 in Chromium.
Direct Apply of explicit null previously coerced options to defaults; state and browser checks now retain invalid text and make no tool call.
A deterministic canceled reply exposed false disconnection in the original onerror handler. The final browser suite requires preserved connection and subsequent successful preview/save.
The documented palette-comparison CLI command reproduces the published contact sheet byte-for-byte.
Full-source histogram independently checks exact-cap overflow, alpha weights, 64-bit maximum-image totals and cancellation. A deliberate double-rounding mutation fails the original-sum centroid test.

Implicit mask_input previously produced a recipe without its external mask requirement. Save/load/replay now reproduces the preview and missing masks fail before publication, with caller-owned mask options unchanged.

Random styles exercise signed safe seeds, omission, zero, rejected null/fraction/string/overflow/unknown fields, 512 styles, all 41 algorithms, real MCP transport, reproducible rendering and no workspace reads/writes.

Six rapid random clicks hold actual Go/HTTP generation and preview responses and release them out of order. Only the newest preview restores recipe authority; old cleanup cannot clear a new operation.
Recipe state/browser tests cover extracted custom colors, hidden options, independent export dimensions, matched receipts, collisions, dirty/unsupported/pending states and masked save/load/replay.
The documentation example initially omitted checking the recipe-save MCP isError result. Independent real-stdio collision testing caught it, and the corrected example now reports the failure.

History restores exact canonical requests, not regenerated seeds or cached PNGs. Real stdio and browser tests verify byte-identical Undo/Redo images, masked recipe replay and refreshed source fingerprints after source bytes change.

Independent review found the normal preview subset matcher accepted added options during history restore. Exact request equality now rejects the response; reinstating the old matcher fails the added-brightness regression.

History state tests cover branch retention, MRU promotion, capacity/pruning, clone isolation, duplicate settings, initial/manual previews, new host input, busy/no-tools guards and failed/canceled/edited/superseded requests.

Browser tests restore invalid JSON and custom-color drafts only after successful preview. Delayed restoration and random supersession cannot restore old recipe authority; explicit saves replay the current restored look.
limitations: Only native macOS arm64 was exercised in this pass.
Standard codecs may work between writer calls; a blocked external writer cannot be interrupted by context checks.
Service-level cancellation admission test uses a pre-canceled request; deterministic mid-encoding tests cover the engine and bounded helper.
Finite seeded simulations and mutations do not prove Go or UI refinement.
External MCP hosts, MCP Inspector, static showcase and terminal recordings were not rerun. Current studio screenshots and palette contact sheet were regenerated.
No vulnerability audit was rerun because dependencies did not change; earlier advisory results remain historical.
The repository has no hosted CI.
Full-source scans increase work on large low-color images. More than 262144 distinct colors fold into 6-bit/channel bins; reduction to 2–256 output colors may still merge rare colors.
The active histogram key count is bounded, but the exact map, 8 MiB overflow bins and result storage may temporarily coexist. Allocation measurements are not peak resident memory.
Random seed selection is reproducible within the current engine/catalog version. Recipes retain settings; future engine versions need not reproduce exact output bytes.

Look history is session-local, limited to20 recently used canonical requests and20 entries per navigation stack. Restoration rereads current source/mask files; it does not preserve historical source bytes or undo published files.
independent_review: Engine, Go/API/schema, studio/embedding, bounded history/navigation, specs/models and runnable examples independently reviewed. History review corrected exact-response validation and a duplicate-seed capacity fixture. All58 JavaScript tests,15000 state transitions, exact-matcher mutation and real browser restoration/authority checks passed. Earlier substantiated findings remain fixed.

performance.method: Median of three local benchmark runs on Apple M3 Pro, Go 1.27.0, 16 requested colors, fixture creation excluded. Old branch implementation compared with new full-source histogram. Illustrative fixtures, not a throughput guarantee.
performance.allocated_bytes_note: Total allocated bytes per operation, not peak memory.
performance.coverage_note: The old pattern sample saw 4 of 16 colors at1024 and 1 of 16 at4096; full scans include all16. Fixed bins reduced an initial high-diversity4096 implementation from112MB to37.8MB allocated/op.
